import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Transaction-level dataset
data = {
    'customer_id': [1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 3, 4],
    'transaction_date': pd.to_datetime(['2024-01-01', '2024-02-15', '2024-03-20',
                                         '2024-01-10', '2024-03-05',
                                         '2024-01-05', '2024-02-10', '2024-03-15', '2024-04-01',
                                         '2024-02-20']),
    'amount': [100, 200, 150, 300, 250, 50, 75, 100, 125, 400]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Calculate per-customer aggregation features
agg_features = df.groupby('customer_id')['amount'].agg(
    mean_amount='mean',
    total_amount='sum',
    transaction_count='count',
    std_amount='std'
).reset_index()

# Calculate days since first transaction (tenure)
tenure = df.groupby('customer_id')['transaction_date'].agg(
    first_txn='min',
    last_txn='max'
).reset_index()
tenure['tenure_days'] = (tenure['last_txn'] - tenure['first_txn']).dt.days

# Calculate average transaction frequency (transactions per month)
tenure['txn_per_month'] = tenure['transaction_count'] / (tenure['tenure_days'] / 30).replace(0, 1)

# Merge aggregation features back
customer_features = agg_features.merge(
    tenure[['customer_id', 'tenure_days', 'txn_per_month']],
    on='customer_id'
)

# Print the customer-level feature table
print("Customer-Level Features:")
print(customer_features)
